title: Rockchip boards
summary: Prepare a Luckfox Lyra or another RK3506 board over the box's USB: erase its onboard flash so that it starts from its SD card. rkdeveloptool and adb, used by Rockchip boards on /admin, with the RK3506 and RK3506B loaders that irate-box ships.
consent: Erasing a board's flash deletes the system on it, and it cannot be undone. adb can also open a shell on a board that runs Android's debugging service.
notes: Connect the board's USB port to a USB port of the box. A board that runs its factory system is switched to Loader mode for you. Otherwise hold its boot (Maskrom) button while you connect it.
